trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback:**
1. Checked deployment history — v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0. The first attempt failed partway (only us-east was rolled back).
3. Retried the rollback — all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0.
4. Verified service status: **healthy**, error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident:**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0002** ("checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deployment") — the on-call engineer has been paged. The incident notes the partial rollback failure and that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the health check failures are root-caused.
